name: factory-line
description: A full era-1-to-era-2 run on one seed: hand-farms the field for cash, researches the fabrication branch and the Workshop Charter, builds Washer → belts → Slicer → Fryer → Seasoner → Bagger with five grabber arms between them, paints and renames a Grow Zone, buys a Speed dial on the Fryer, feeds the line by hand, sells the bags, then researches the seed hopper and arms auto-replant. Exercises every Command variant added with the factory. Every command here was applied, not attempted — the list is the world’s own input trace.
